summary: New Providence Acquisition Corp. III issued unsecured promissory notes totaling $1.5 million to co-CEOs Gary Smith and Alexander Coleman for working capital. The notes bear no interest, mature upon business combination or liquidation, and are convertible into units at $10 per unit, each comprising one Class A share and one-third warrant. A prior $200,000 sponsor advance is payable on demand. This is a routine SPAC working capital facility, not a business combination or special situation.
